production.per_attempt.basis: Production-phase agents of 34 batches with a tally, divided by 1041 orders attempted in those non-correction batches. Producer batches without a tally (o25) are excluded from numerator and denominator. Model family taken from each agent's recorded model.

review.per_submitted.basis: Review-phase agents whose batches are all tallied production batches, divided by 622 blind-review verdicts (upheld + rejected, summed from blind_review_verdicts in DISPOSITION); one verdict is one claim version judged, so re-reviews of revised versions and planted controls count. Excluded review agents (paired trial arms, re-review, untallied batches): lind-a03-A, lind-a03-B, lind-c01-A, lind-c01-B, lind-c02-A, lind-c02-B, lind-c03-A, lind-c03-B, rereview-n01. Model family taken from each agent's recorded model.

coordination.per_attempt.basis: Coordinator agent, divided by 1041 production orders attempted. Lower bound: the coordinator transcript covers only the period after a context compaction. Model family taken from each agent's recorded model.

wave.per_attempt.basis: production.per_attempt + review.per_submitted x submit share (622/1041 = 0.5975 verdicts per attempted order) + coordination.per_attempt.

wave.per_filed_dossier.basis: Same total as wave.per_attempt divided by 492 claims filed in production batches. A filed claim is not a certified dossier.

correction.per_attempt.basis: Correction-production agents (3), divided by 83 orders attempted in c01-c03. Their review is not separated from the review phase above. Model family taken from each agent's recorded model.
